attributes.name: Vescavor Queen
attributes.powers:
The Vescavor Queen is immune to the Acid and Poison traits. All damage dealt by the Vescavor Queen is Acid damage.

The difficulty of checks to defeat that do not have the Ranged or Attack trait is increased by 1d6.

If undefeated, a random character at your location is dealt 1d4-1 Acid damage.
